title: Sector Explorer - Verdantis

hero.intro: The plot's bounding box split into 5×5-pixel sectors (partial at the edges). Choose NDWI or NDMI, then click a sector to see its own moisture history against ERA5 temperature for the same months - the whole-plot average, on the right, is the default view.

detail.selection_hint_default: click any sector to inspect it

footer_html: Data: Sentinel-2 L2A monthly median composites via Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (openEO), clipped to the client plot; NDWI = (B08-B11)/(B08+B11) (broad NIR); NDMI = (B8A-B11)/(B8A+B11) (narrow NIR) - same family, highly correlated but not identical. Temperature: ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo's archive API. "Dry frequency" is the % of valid months the selected index fell below the threshold dryness threshold; "dry magnitude" is how far below threshold it typically fell on those months. Generated from outputs/monthly_ndvi_ndwi_ndmi.nc and outputs/era5_temperature_monthly.csv, published via publish_site.py - no live data connection. Looking for the monthly NDVI/NDWI/NDMI imagery slider that used to live here? It's now on the Monitoring & Alerts page, alongside current conditions and vegetation-break alerts.
